instruction: I want to disable breadcrumbs navigation in the editor, please help modify the setting of VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to disable breadcrumbs navigation in the editor. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly applied in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings from the proper file location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly parses JSON and verifies expected key-value pairs with strict equality
Expected value 'breadcrumbs.enabled: false' is semantically correct for disabling breadcrumbs navigation in VS Code
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact setting required by the instruction
No postconfig needed: settings.json persists after task completion and is accessible for verification
Data flow is correct: VM file getter -> JSON parsing -> key-value verification against expected settings
Error handling present: metric returns 0.0 on JSON parse failures

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
